sections.name: ShareCard
sections.title: Share card layout
sections.what: Builds the card: brand name at the top, the call title in the middle, and the display name, moment and grade in the footer, labelled as a share card.
sections.why: Likely reason: it is meant to be shown or captured as a social image, as its size comment suggests.
sections.watch_out: This is a web element, not an image file, so a saved picture needs a separate step that is not in this file.

summary: A shareable card showing a called outcome, its grade and the moment, using only a display name.
purpose: Lets a fan share a graded call without exposing personal details.
why: The comment says it uses the display name only and contains no prize language.
how: Lays out the brand name, the call title, and a footer with the display name, moment and grade, inside a figure element sized to a 1200 by 630 ratio.
inputs: displayName, title, grade and moment, all as text.
outputs: A card element on screen. The code does not show how it becomes an image.
risks: Long titles or names may crowd the card. Passing a real legal name would reveal it.
debug: If the layout breaks, check the text lengths and the share card style rules.
